tools_helpful.evidence: Ran the full mechanical check suite; correctly PASSed image refs, Windows.Desktop target + rescap:runFullTrust, and a 0-WUI-warning build.

tools_problematic.problem: Reported the decisive launch failure as a benign environment WARN and returned overall PASS, so the agent declared the migration done on an app that never launches.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt ~L9145: '[WARN] Smoke launch ... not a migration defect ... ==> Validate-UwpMigration: PASS'; winapp run error 0x80073CF6 / AppxManifest.xml(35,10) windows.dialProtocol extension: The request is not supported.

tool_limitations.limitation: The no-AUMID branch classifies ALL registration failures as 'unavailable' (Developer Mode off / missing framework / MAX_PATH), even when winapp's error string is a manifest-content registration failure (a real migration defect).
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Detect manifest-registration HRESULTs (0x80073CF6 with AppxManifest.xml / 'extension ... is not supported') and classify them as a defect, not environment.

tool_limitations.limitation: Section 5b lints TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust but never inspects carried-over <uap:Extension> blocks that can block package registration.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a static manifest lint that flags UWP-only extensions known to fail packaged WinUI 3 registration (windows.dialProtocol, ...).

doc_errors.wrong: Instructs the agent to merge UWP manifest content '(capabilities, file-type associations, <uap:Extension>, <Application Id>, etc.)' into the scaffold manifest, implying <uap:Extension> blocks should be carried over verbatim.
doc_errors.correct: UWP app-model <Extensions> (e.g. windows.dialProtocol) often cannot register under a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app and abort registration (whole app fails to launch). Carry over only extensions you know register; strip unsupported/unneeded ones.

special_apis.special_handling: Does not register for a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app on Win10/11 (0x80073CF6 / 0x80070032 'The request is not supported'); must be removed from Package.appxmanifest unless a supported equivalent is wired up. The C# DialProtocol APIs are separate and may still compile/run.

errors_encountered.error: AppxManifest.xml(35,10): error 0x80070032: Cannot register ... windows.dialProtocol extension: The request is not supported. (0x80073CF6)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migrated Package.appxmanifest carried over the original UWP <uap:Extension Category="windows.dialProtocol"> block; that extension is not registrable for a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app, so the package never registers and the app never launches.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the windows.dialProtocol <uap:Extension> from the WinUI 3 Package.appxmanifest (keep capabilities/assets/runFullTrust).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent treated the package-registration failure as an environment problem and declared the migration complete; app scores 0 because it never launches.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 told the agent the failure was 'not a migration defect' (no AUMID => env), and Validate returned PASS, so the agent had no signal that a real defect existed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Tooling that classifies manifest-registration failures as defects (Test-AppLaunch.ps1) + a static manifest lint flagging unregisterable UWP extensions (Validate-UwpMigration.ps1), plus a doc fix telling the agent to strip unsupported <Extensions>.

missing_tooling.need: A manifest lint for UWP-only <Extensions> that block packaged WinUI 3 registration
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire 0-score: the defect would have surfaced as a FAIL before the agent declared done.
